edges.label: author's employer at time of writing (Skunk Works)
edges.note: Lockheed Martin is the affiliation recorded on the DIA congressional list. Macheret was a senior staff engineer at Lockheed Martin Aeronautics, Skunk Works, from 2006 to 2014, bracketing the document's ICOD and publication date. Lockheed Martin is credited with three of the 38 products on the DIA list.

a.label: MHD Air Breathing Propulsion and Power for Aerospace Applications

edges.label: authored by
edges.note: The DIA congressional list credits 'Magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) Air Breathing Propulsion and Power for Aerospace Applications' to 'Dr S Macheret, Lockheed Martin'. Macheret is a plasma physicist (Ph.D., Kurchatov Institute) with a substantial peer-reviewed record in MHD flow control, and this DIRD is among the most conventionally grounded on the list.
